attribute_fields.COMMENTS: NewHampshire state income tax (2025). Effectively no income tax in 2025 (RSA 77 (I&D tax phased out 2025)). Writes result.computed_state_tax = 0.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " New Hampshire (Interest & Dividends tax phased out 2025)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " New Hampshire (Interest & Dividends tax phased out 2025)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: New Hampshire taxes no earned income, and the 3% Interest & Dividends tax was repealed by HB 2 (2023 session) effective for taxable periods beginning after 2024-12-31 — a 2025 return owes nothing. Source: NH DRA, Repeal of NH Interest and Dividends Tax Now in Effect. Verified 2026-08-26 (#443).
action_details.action_dsl: /* no-op: tax already zeroed in initial_action */
